fidelityReview.notes: Individual rebuilt al-Nuri mosque visualization: retained hall plan, a green central dome, four short corner turrets, pointed hall gallery, side courtyard arcades, small octagonal fountain pavilion and the separate tall northwestern brick Al-Hadba minaret. Shared low-contrast textures, original geometry, no copied photographs, inscriptions, furnished interiors or museum/visitor-center additions. The site extension and vertical proportions remain explicitly approximate. No retained published height/width/length facts and no current PMTiles part heights are available. All vertical values are explicit picture/footprint-scale estimates: hall roof8.5 m, main drum10.8 m, green dome19 m/finial20.5 m, four short turret finials16.8 m, Al-Hadba finial45 m with an estimated1.6 m eastward offset, courtyard arcade eaves7 m and fountain pavilion roof6.8 m. The lean direction/magnitude are not surveyed. Gallery bay count, dome profiles, minaret bands, fountain, paving and site extension are visualization reconstruction. Retained historic=ruins is preserved verbatim rather than presented as current appearance. This is a reconstructed exterior visualization guided by two useful recent exterior photographs, retained hall geometry and ordinary viewer map/DEM. The current map is stale about destruction and has no replacement building outline. Exact rebuilt court dimensions, lean vector, roof construction, fountain position and thresholds are unverified. The central duplicate minaret marker is kept as an ambiguity, not multiplied into a second tower. Neighboring museums, visitor facilities and the city remain host content.
